retake.attemptCapPeriod: Online: up to 2 attempts within a 6-month period

gdl.nightCurfew: First 12 months: no driving midnight-6 a.m.; second 12 months (or until 18): no driving 1 a.m.-5 a.m. (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 12 months: no more than 1 non-family passenger unless a parent/guardian is present

requiredDocuments: Proof of full legal name and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Ohio residency (for adults / REAL ID)
For applicants under 18: consent of a parent or legal guardian and proof of school enrollment/graduation
process.realIdNotes: Ohio issues both compliant (REAL ID) and standard licenses. A compliant card requires one document for full legal name/date of birth, one for SSN, and two proving Ohio residency. A U.S. passport can be used for federal purposes instead.
process.permitFee: $26.50 for a Temporary Instruction Permit Identification Card (TIPIC)
process.licenseFee: Age-based: $28.75 at age 16, $27.50 at 17, and $26.25 at 18; other ages follow the BMV fee schedule
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 or more points within a 2-year period results in a 6-month license suspension, plus a remedial driving course and a driver's license reexamination before reinstatement
facts.moveOverRule: Move Over Law: move over one lane when approaching a stopped emergency, road-service, or maintenance vehicle with flashing lights; if moving over is unsafe, slow down and proceed with caution
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph on rural interstates and turnpike where posted
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph during recess and while children are arriving or leaving, during posted school hours
